body_html:
Meet D’Juan, also known as DJ Voncil, hailing from the vibrant state of California! With a wealth of experience in the entertainment industry, he brings his dynamic skills to the table, having conquered various arenas such as Radio and Mobile DJ events. His expertise spans diverse occasions, from weddings and school dances to sports fan zones, community events, Mitzvahs, and beyond. DJ Voncil has been spinning tracks since 2005, infusing his sets with a contagious energy that keeps the party alive.

Among his favorite go-to songs are the timeless “I Wanna Dance with Somebody,” the crowd-pleasing “The Wobble,” and the ever-energetic tracks from LMFAO. When he’s not behind the DJ booth, D’Juan loves embracing new adventures and constantly seeks opportunities to learn something fresh. Beyond his musical prowess, he boasts additional talents such as cutting his own hair, writing scripts, and lending his voice to captivating voiceovers.

Curious about what’s playing in D’Juan’s headphones? You can expect a mix of Top 40 hits, Hip Hop beats, Alternative vibes, Oldies grooves, Classic Rock anthems, and soulful R&B melodies. DJ Voncil is not just a DJ; he’s a versatile entertainer ready to elevate your event to new heights!
